name: AS-REP roasting (Kerberos pre-auth disabled)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4768 | where PreAuthenticationType == 0 | where AccountName !in (legacyAllowed)
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4768 PreAuthType=0 OR PreAuthenticationType=0
tuning: Any 4768 with PreAuthenticationType=0 = roastable account; disable pre-auth for anomalies.
